people.title: People permissions
people.description: See what each person can do, why they have access, and adjust it. Everything is organized by person to avoid mixing different concepts.
people.hint: Pick a person to see their effective access broken down by source (Profile | Group | Grant | Restriction), what the Scope Engine resolves, and make changes below.
people.selectPrompt: Select a person to see their access.

sections.readAccessDescription: View what this person can actually do and the reasons behind it.
sections.whatDeterminesAccessDescription: Contexts and scope explain why the person is eligible for certain capabilities.
sections.capabilitiesMatrixDescription: Effective permissions grouped by module. Expand a row to see sources and reasons.

contexts.title: Contexts
contexts.description: The contexts this person belongs to (based on their assignments). These help explain eligibility.

scope.title: Scope (resolved)
scope.description: What the Scope Engine currently resolves for this person. This is read-only verification.

matrix.actionError: Could not save this change. Please try again.

empty.noPermissions: This person has no effective permissions in the visible modules.

help.effectivePermissions: Effective permissions = the result after applying profiles, groups, grants, and restrictions. Sources show the reasoning.
